runtimeSurfaces.visibilityGate: All runtime consumers must ask AppWorkloadPolicy for visible, hidden, foreground, background, and active-walk budgets.
runtimeSurfaces.lowPowerGate: ambientMotionBudget returns static and refreshBudget returns throttled when Low Power Mode is active.
runtimeSurfaces.reduceMotionGate: interactionMotionBudget downgrades to efficient and ambientMotionBudget returns static when Reduce Motion is active.
runtimeSurfaces.backgroundGate: ambient work pauses in background except explicitly active walk refreshes.
runtimeSurfaces.evidence: AppWorkloadPolicy probes policy changes through AppPerformanceMonitor and is invoked by high-traffic views.

runtimeSurfaces.visibilityGate: Location can stay active only while PetWalkingManager has an active dog walk.
runtimeSurfaces.lowPowerGate: Non-walk refreshes are throttled or paused by AppWorkloadPolicy; active-walk refreshes use the explicit active-walk exception.
runtimeSurfaces.reduceMotionGate: Map cosmetic motion must use ambientMotionBudget and can be disabled without stopping location safety.
runtimeSurfaces.backgroundGate: Background location is allowed only for a running walk; paused/stopped/non-walk states stop updates.
runtimeSurfaces.policyGate: scripts/audit-runtime-guardrails.sh --all restricts CLLocationManager and background location to the centralized location files.
runtimeSurfaces.evidence: Runtime guardrails pass full repo; route cosmetic effects are AppWorkloadPolicy gated.

runtimeSurfaces.visibilityGate: Home ambient work may run only while the surface is visible, live, and not covered by a frozen handoff.
runtimeSurfaces.lowPowerGate: Ambient loops must ask AppWorkloadPolicy or SurfaceActivityGate and fall back to static/reduced visuals.
runtimeSurfaces.reduceMotionGate: Reduce Motion disables decorative loops and keeps interaction feedback lightweight.
runtimeSurfaces.backgroundGate: Hidden/off-tab home surfaces are unmounted or rendered as static shells.
runtimeSurfaces.policyGate: scripts/audit-smoothness-risk.sh --all and scripts/audit-runtime-guardrails.sh --all block new unowned loops.
runtimeSurfaces.evidence: Round 3 Oasis host/live snapshot repair; Today Focus and streak particles are policy gated.

runtimeSurfaces.visibilityGate: Use OhanaStaticAppBackground for high-frequency presentation handoffs; animated backgrounds run only when chosen and visible.
runtimeSurfaces.lowPowerGate: ArkBackgroundView switches to static gradients when AppWorkloadPolicy requests static ambient motion.
runtimeSurfaces.reduceMotionGate: Reduce Motion participates in AppWorkloadPolicy and disables ambient background loops.
runtimeSurfaces.backgroundGate: Background ambient loops stop when the app is not foreground through AppWorkloadPolicy.
runtimeSurfaces.policyGate: Runtime guardrails require AppWorkloadPolicy for repeatForever/TimelineView animation files.
runtimeSurfaces.evidence: OhanaStaticAppBackground exists for route opens and ArkBackgroundView consumes AppWorkloadPolicy.

runtimeSurfaces.visibilityGate: Deferred mount tasks are owned by the route/sheet host and cancelled when dismissed or hidden.
runtimeSurfaces.lowPowerGate: Reduced-work modes shorten or remove nonessential visual delays through interactionMotionBudget.
runtimeSurfaces.reduceMotionGate: Reduced Motion uses GoMotion.reduced or shorter delays before content mount.
runtimeSurfaces.backgroundGate: Route-scoped tasks cancel on disappearance rather than continuing in background.
runtimeSurfaces.policyGate: Changed-file smoothness audit and performance SLO manifest track high-frequency route handoffs.
runtimeSurfaces.evidence: Calendar add-event, settings sheets, and Oasis host use cancellable OhanaFrameScheduler tasks.

runtimeSurfaces.visibilityGate: Design preview loops must remain isolated to explicit design/spec routes and never mount in app startup or high-frequency home paths.
runtimeSurfaces.lowPowerGate: Preview canvases must expose reduced-work paths when used in app surfaces.
runtimeSurfaces.reduceMotionGate: Preview canvases consume AppWorkloadPolicy or explicit reduced-work parameters.
runtimeSurfaces.backgroundGate: Preview/lab surfaces are route scoped and should not continue when dismissed.
runtimeSurfaces.policyGate: Runtime guardrails and whole-repo smoothness audit catch new TimelineView(.animation) usage.
runtimeSurfaces.evidence: Design preview files are isolated under design/spec and lab views, not startup.
